Cisco N540X-16Z4G8Q2C-D Router – High-Performance Networking for Next-Gen Connectivity

Upgrade Your Network with the Cisco N540X-16Z4G8Q2C-D Router


The Cisco N540X-16Z4G8Q2C-D is a high-speed, scalable, and carrier-grade router designed for enterprise, service provider, and data center networks. With an advanced port configuration, modular fan tray cooling, and redundant DC power supplies, this router delivers unmatched performance, reliability, and efficiency.


This 1U rack-mountable powerhouse features 16 x 10Gb SFP+, 8 x 25Gb SFP28, and 2 x 100Gb QSFP28 uplink ports, enabling seamless high-speed connectivity for mission-critical applications. With a throughput of up to 300 Mpps, it ensures efficient data processing to support high-bandwidth operations.


Key Features 

  • Powerful Performance – Supports up to 300 million packets per second (Mpps) for ultra-fast data processing.
  • High-Speed Connectivity – 16 x 10Gb SFP+, 8 x 25Gb SFP28, and 2 x 100Gb QSFP28 uplink ports for lightning-fast network performance.
  • Flexible Network Configuration – 4 x 1Gb RJ-45 Gigabit Ethernet ports for versatile connections.
  • Efficient Cooling System – Modular fan tray with redundant fans for enhanced reliability & optimal airflow (side-to-side right to left).
  • Redundant Power Supply – Dual fixed DC power supplies ensure maximum uptime & stability.
  • Compact & Space-Saving – 1U rack-mountable design for easy integration into network infrastructures.
  • Advanced Management Features – USB & RJ-45 console ports for simplified network administration.
  • Carrier-Grade Reliability – Designed for high-availability networking environments.


Technical Specifications

Port Configuration & Performance

Network Ports:

  • 16 x 10Gb SFP+ ports – High-speed optical fiber connectivity
  • 8 x 25Gb SFP28 ports – Enhanced bandwidth for data-intensive applications
  • 2 x 100Gb QSFP28 uplink ports – Superior scalability for high-traffic networks
  • 4 x 1Gb RJ-45 Gigabit Ethernet ports – Flexible network configurations


Throughput: Up to 300 Mpps – Handles high-volume data traffic efficiently.

Rack Mountable: 1U form factor – Compact and ideal for data centers & service providers.


Power & Cooling

  • Power Supply:
  • 2 x Fixed Redundant DC Power Supplies – Ensures uninterrupted operation
  • Energy-Efficient Design – Optimized for low power consumption

  • Cooling System:
  • Modular Fan Tray with Redundant Fans – Side-to-side airflow (right to left) for enhanced cooling


Management & Connectivity

  • USB Console Port – Easy configuration & management.
  • RJ-45 Console Port – Direct access for troubleshooting & monitoring.


Ideal Applications

  • Enterprise & Cloud Networking – Secure & scalable connectivity for businesses.
  • Service Provider Networks – High-capacity broadband aggregation & backhaul.
  • Data Center Interconnects – Fast, reliable fiber-optic networking.
  • Metro Ethernet Deployments – High-speed aggregation & switching solutions.
  • Financial & High-Speed Trading Networks – Low-latency data processing.


Why Choose the Cisco N540X-16Z4G8Q2C-D Router?

  • Industry-Leading Performance – Built for high-speed data processing & scalability.
  • Advanced Features & Reliability – Redundant power, efficient cooling, and enterprise-grade security.
  • Optimized for High-Traffic Networks – Handles bandwidth-intensive applications with ease.
  • Space-Saving & Energy-Efficient – 1U rack-mountable design & power-efficient operation.
  • Future-Proof Connectivity – Supports next-gen high-speed networking requirements.
